About the Role
Australasian Stone is seeking a skilled and reliable Stonemason to join our growing team in Mount Waverley. As a premier provider of waterproofing, tiling, and stone masonry services across Melbourne's commercial and civil construction sectors, we take pride in the precision and craftsmanship of everything we deliver. In this role, you will work alongside a team of over 100 dedicated trade professionals, contributing to projects that range from commercial high-rises to civil infrastructure developments.
This is an opportunity to bring your trade skills to a business that values quality, takes its work seriously, and gives its people the projects and support to do their best work.

Key Responsibilities
- Interpret complex blueprints and technical specifications to ensure accurate material planning, site preparation, and project execution.
- Utilize advanced machinery and manual techniques for the precise cutting, shaping, and finishing of stone and masonry components to meet exact project tolerances.
- Construct structural and aesthetic masonry installations, ensuring integrity and adherence to architectural design requirements.
- Apply binding agents and mortars to secure masonry units, maintaining structural alignment, consistent jointing, and required leveling standards.
- Implement moisture-proofing and protective sealing measures to ensure the long-term durability and structural integrity of foundations and surfaces.
- Coordinate the safe setup and dismantling of work platforms and low-level scaffolding in compliance with site safety regulations.
- Perform comprehensive maintenance, repair, and restoration services on existing masonry and stonework installations.
- Deliver specialized masonry services, including intricate design work and custom detailing, as necessitated by specific project scopes.

About You
- Trade-qualified with an AQF Certificate III or IV in stonemasonry, or a related discipline, or a minimum of three years relevant experience in lieu
- Demonstrated hands-on experience laying bricks, blocks, or stonework in a commercial or civil construction environment
- Strong attention to detail with a commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality finishes
- Able to read and interpret technical plans and specifications
- Physically fit and capable of performing the demands of the role safely
- Holds, or is eligible to obtain, any required registration or licensing
- A reliable team player with a professional approach to work and safety on site

The Company

At Comunet, we love great tech—but what really drives us is what it makes possible. For 30 years, we’ve been helping organisations get more from their IT, whether that means tightening security, modernising legacy environments, reducing complexity, or setting them up for what’s next. We work with smart people, solve real problems, and build technology that genuinely makes life easier for our clients.? 

We’re big on curiosity, initiative, and people who genuinely enjoy figuring things out. We like teammates who can dive into a technical challenge, collaborate well, share what they know, and still keep things light along the way. Culture matters here, and we invest in it—with a strong Employee Value Proposition, Friday drinks, team events, whole-of-business catchups, and a fully stocked pantry. We work hard, support each other, and make sure there’s room to grow, experiment, and enjoy the ride.? 

We invest in our people through certified and flexible training, flexible work options, and strong support structures. We also believe in promoting from within and take pride in seeing our people grow and succeed. 



About the Role

The Support Engineer role at Comunet is not an entry-level position—it’s for someone who already has solid runs on the board and enjoys getting stuck into complex technical problems. You’ll be a key escalation point within our support team, taking ownership of issues across networking, cloud, security, infrastructure, and more. We’re looking for someone who can work with confidence, think critically, and bring the kind of hands-on experience that helps solve the tougher challenges when they land. 

At its core, this role is about keeping client and internal environments secure, stable, and performing at a high standard—but it also comes with real responsibility. This is a role for someone who can operate with a fair degree of autonomy, make sound technical decisions, and contribute meaningfully across both BAU support and project work. You’ll also help guide graduate and entry-level team members, share your knowledge, and lift the capability of the wider team through experience, mentorship, and technical leadership. 

We operate 6am - 6pm Monday to Friday to service our clients and shifts will fall within these hours on a rotating basis. 

 Applicants must have the legal right to work in Australia on an ongoing basis. 



Key Responsibilities:

Deliver high-quality IT support to our clients, with a strong focus on responsiveness, professionalism, and customer service. 

Provide guidance and mentoring to IT Support Analysts, interns, and other junior team members, helping build technical capability across the team. 

Manage support tickets effectively, ensuring client requests are accurately logged, updated, prioritised, and progressed through to resolution. 

Deliver remote and phone-based support for escalated and technology-specific issues across a broad range of client environments. 

Contribute to onsite support activities and assist with project delivery, technical implementations, and other assigned tasks as required. 

Maintain, patch, monitor, and upgrade IT environments to support reliability, performance, and security outcomes. 

Ensure work is tracked in timesheets for client services and personal development activities. 

Support and administer core IT infrastructure and cloud-based systems, applying strong technical skills across modern business environments. 



 Key technical skills:

Knowledge of basic networking (routing and switching). 

2+ years of experience in Windows Server Administration. This is expected to include familiarity with Active Directory, Group Policy, and management of common server roles. 

2+ years of experience in Microsoft 365 administration (with exposure to hybrid Exchange environments considered highly desirable). 

AWS and/or Azure skills highly desirable. 

Demonstrate a strong knowledge of security practises and controls. 



Attributes we look for:

You’ll bring at least two years of IT experience, along with relevant qualifications or certifications, and be ready to build on your existing knowledge. You’ll enjoy working with clients to solve technical challenges and help deliver stable, secure, and reliable platforms for their business. 



How to Apply

We'd love a cover letter with your CV addressing why you should be the suitable candidate to join us. 

As this is active ongoing recruitment process the position may be filled with the right applicant before the published closing date - so we encourage applications as early as possible.  

By submitting an application to Comunet, you acknowledge that we will undertake workforce screening activities including, but not limited to: Reference checks, National Crime and Right to Work Checks, Identity and certification verification.

Only candidates that are short listed will be contacted.

Queensland

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our elite sales team is made up of passionate, dedicated professionals, delivering the most advanced medical technologies to patients in need. By collaborating extensively with leading healthcare professionals you’ll see first-hand the impact you have on individual lives - one patient at a time. 

The position of Clinical Specialist, Electrophysiology (EP), provides field/remote clinical, technical & educational support in EP to assigned accounts across ANZ. The primary focus is to support new therapy introduction of Pulsed Field Ablation through our recent launch of the FARAPULSE™ system, demonstrating clinical expertise to influence superior outcomes. Frequent travel will be required as part of the role. 

The Clinical Specialist – Electrophysiology role is based in Queensland and reports to the Field Clinical Specialist Manager.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

•	Utilising your technical knowledge of:
o	The field of electrophysiology (including propagation of electrical circuits within cardiac tissue and the pathophysiology of electrical rhythm disorders), biophysics of radiofrequency, cryo-thermal ablation, 2D and 3D electroanatomical mapping principles to provide:
?	Clinical support including basic trouble-shooting, and clinical guidance to diagnose and treat cardiac arrhythmias
?	Provide the measurement of electrical circuits within the heart and perform stimulation protocols as per physician requests to measure the electrical conductivity of the heart to aid in the diagnosis of cardiac arrhythmias
?	Develop a deep technical understanding of, and provide the technical training of company products to Cardiac Electrophysiologists, Cardiac Physiologists and Nurses
•	Travelling as required to meet customer demand for the services described above.
•	Attending cases face to face (or remotely) with customers, operating Boston Scientific products where appropriate, and providing detailed training / advice to physicians on clinical attributes / techniques associated with Boston Scientific electrophysiology products including:
o	Providing clinical support for: FARAPULSE™, OPAL™, RHYTHMIA™, LAB SYSTEM PRO™, MAESTRO 4000™, METRIQ™, plus support for the full range of Boston Scientific EP Catheters
•	Developing deep understanding on the workflows and specificities of each hospital & business relationships with hospital personnel (e.g., through informal conversation, meetings, participation in conferences) to make new contacts in other departments within hospital and all stakeholders to ensure that products are trained and utilised in accordance with the Directions for Use.
•	Ensuring timely collection, reporting of all required medical documentation pertaining to our procedural device operation.
•	Responding to complex customer needs and complaints regarding products and service by developing creative and feasible solutions or working with other related personnel (e.g., sales, clinical, research, marketing, technical support) to develop optimal solutions.
•	Recording customer information and activities in company’s CRM system: use the system as an alignment tool with other commercial roles.
•	Completion of relevant administration including reporting, stock validations and inventory management
•	Attending meetings, conferences and exhibitions as required to promote Boston Scientific products and services.
•	Being available to support the broader ANZ Rhythm Management business on an as-needs basis

KEY COMPETENCIES REQUIRED FOR SUCCESS 

Product/Technical Knowledge
•	Successfully completes all relevant Electrophysiology training. 
•	Develop in depth knowledge of Electrophysiology procedure, products and treatment applications.
•	Proactively keeps up to date with technical knowledge in Electrophysiology.

Relationship Building 
•	Builds and maintains effective networks that add value in achieving work related goals.
•	Skilled in building rapport with a wide variety of individuals.
•	Understands the balance between taking time to build rapport and achieving objectives set.
•	Works effectively and collaboratively within the team environment.

Adaptability 

•	Responds resourcefully, flexibly, and positively when faced with new challenges and demands. 
•	Moves forward productively and optimistically under conditions of change or uncertainty.

Organisation & Reporting
•	Maintains well organised materials, files, system and reports.
•	Plans and prioritises territory activity.
•	Makes sure all parts of a job are completed in full, within deadlines, including follow-up plans and documentation.

Results Focused
•	Demonstrates a growth mindset.
•	Measures own performance and seeks feedback for self-development
•	Demonstrates resilience and has a strong sense of urgency
•	Recognises and acts on opportunities.
•	Maintains a flexible approach to meet goals

YOUR EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

•	Clinical case experience within Electrophysiology / Cardiac Rhythm Management is highly regarded
•	Understanding of conventional Electrophysiology (EP), including EP signal interpretation, 3D Mapping, Cryoablation and Troubleshooting experience is highly regarded
•	Knowledge of Cardiac Electrophysiology principles, including Radiofrequency, Cryoablation, and Pulsed Field Ablation (PFA)
•	Tertiary qualifications in biomedical engineering, science or a related field 
•	Desired qualifications in IBHRE EP, IBHRE Pacing
•	Strong technical and clinical skills
•	Demonstrated expertise in building and maintaining strong relationships.
•	Proven ability to absorb complex technical information and apply this knowledge in the field.
•	Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our elite sales team is made up of passionate, dedicated professionals, delivering the most advanced medical technologies to patients in need. By collaborating extensively with leading healthcare professionals you’ll see first-hand the impact you have on individual lives - one patient at a time. 

The position of Clinical Specialist, Electrophysiology (EP), provides field/remote clinical, technical & educational support in EP to assigned accounts across ANZ. The primary focus is to support new therapy introduction of Pulsed Field Ablation through our recent launch of the FARAPULSE™ system, demonstrating clinical expertise to influence superior outcomes. Frequent travel will be required as part of the role. 

The Clinical Specialist – Electrophysiology role is based in New South Wales and reports to the Field Clinical Specialist Manager.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

•	Utilising your technical knowledge of:
o	The field of electrophysiology (including propagation of electrical circuits within cardiac tissue and the pathophysiology of electrical rhythm disorders), biophysics of radiofrequency, cryo-thermal ablation, 2D and 3D electroanatomical mapping principles to provide:
?	Clinical support including basic trouble-shooting, and clinical guidance to diagnose and treat cardiac arrhythmias
?	Provide the measurement of electrical circuits within the heart and perform stimulation protocols as per physician requests to measure the electrical conductivity of the heart to aid in the diagnosis of cardiac arrhythmias
?	Develop a deep technical understanding of, and provide the technical training of company products to Cardiac Electrophysiologists, Cardiac Physiologists and Nurses
•	Travelling as required to meet customer demand for the services described above.
•	Attending cases face to face (or remotely) with customers, operating Boston Scientific products where appropriate, and providing detailed training / advice to physicians on clinical attributes / techniques associated with Boston Scientific electrophysiology products including:
o	Providing clinical support for: FARAPULSE™, OPAL™, RHYTHMIA™, LAB SYSTEM PRO™, MAESTRO 4000™, METRIQ™, plus support for the full range of Boston Scientific EP Catheters
•	Developing deep understanding on the workflows and specificities of each hospital & business relationships with hospital personnel (e.g., through informal conversation, meetings, participation in conferences) to make new contacts in other departments within hospital and all stakeholders to ensure that products are trained and utilised in accordance with the Directions for Use.
•	Ensuring timely collection, reporting of all required medical documentation pertaining to our procedural device operation.
•	Responding to complex customer needs and complaints regarding products and service by developing creative and feasible solutions or working with other related personnel (e.g., sales, clinical, research, marketing, technical support) to develop optimal solutions.
•	Recording customer information and activities in company’s CRM system: use the system as an alignment tool with other commercial roles.
•	Completion of relevant administration including reporting, stock validations and inventory management
•	Attending meetings, conferences and exhibitions as required to promote Boston Scientific products and services.
•	Being available to support the broader ANZ Rhythm Management business on an as-needs basis

KEY COMPETENCIES REQUIRED FOR SUCCESS 

Product/Technical Knowledge
•	Successfully completes all relevant Electrophysiology training. 
•	Develop in depth knowledge of Electrophysiology procedure, products and treatment applications.
•	Proactively keeps up to date with technical knowledge in Electrophysiology.

Relationship Building 
•	Builds and maintains effective networks that add value in achieving work related goals.
•	Skilled in building rapport with a wide variety of individuals.
•	Understands the balance between taking time to build rapport and achieving objectives set.
•	Works effectively and collaboratively within the team environment.

Adaptability 

•	Responds resourcefully, flexibly, and positively when faced with new challenges and demands. 
•	Moves forward productively and optimistically under conditions of change or uncertainty.

Organisation & Reporting
•	Maintains well organised materials, files, system and reports.
•	Plans and prioritises territory activity.

Results Focused
•	Demonstrates a growth mindset.
•	Measures own performance and seeks feedback for self-development
•	Demonstrates resilience and has a strong sense of urgency
•	Recognises and acts on opportunities.
•	Maintains a flexible approach to meet goals

YOUR EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

•	Clinical case experience within Electrophysiology / Cardiac Rhythm Management is highly regarded
•	Understanding of conventional Electrophysiology (EP), including EP signal interpretation, 3D Mapping, Cryoablation and Troubleshooting experience is highly regarded
•	Knowledge of Cardiac Electrophysiology principles, including Radiofrequency, Cryoablation, and Pulsed Field Ablation (PFA)
•	Tertiary qualifications in biomedical engineering, science or a related field 
•	Desired qualifications in IBHRE EP, IBHRE Pacing

We are posting on behalf of our client Octa for the position of Electrical Engineer.

Position Purpose:

The Electrical Engineer is a central resource that provides electrical engineering expertise to support safe, reliable, and efficient operations, and successful delivery of capital projects across OCTA Group’s industrial portfolio.
The role works across operations, maintenance, reliability, engineering studies, and project execution, with exposure to OCTA’s, thermal (Gas) and renewable (Solar, Wind, BESS) power stations as well as its’ LNG production and customer facilities.

Key Responsibilities:

Operations & Asset Support:
-  Provide day-to-day electrical engineering support to operations and maintenance teams, ensuring equipment performance and reliability.
-  Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis of electrical equipment failures (HV/LV distribution, motors, VSDs, switchgear, protection systems, UPS/DC systems, and control systems interfaces).
- Review and approve technical documentation, operating procedures, work packs, and maintenance strategies.
-  Support asset integrity programs including inspection regimes, obsolescence management, and critical spares strategies.
-  Provide engineering input into plant modifications, isolations, shutdown/turnaround scopes, and management of change (MOC) processes.

Project Engineering & Delivery:
-  Provide electrical engineering input across project phases: concept, FEED, detailed design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and close-out.
-  Prepare and review technical scopes of work, specifications, datasheets, single line diagrams (SLDs), and design documentation.
-  Support procurement activities including vendor evaluations, bid technical assessments, FAT/SAT planning, and vendor document reviews.
-  Manage technical interfaces with other specialists (mechanical, controls, process, civil, instrumentation).
-  Support commissioning, energisation plans, punch list closure, and handover into operations.

Engineering Governance & Compliance:
-  Ensure all engineering activities comply with applicable standards and regulations (e.g., AS/NZS, IEC, IEEE, site standards).
-  Conduct and participate in technical reviews and risk assessments including HAZOP/HAZID and electrical safety studies.
-  Support electrical safety and compliance activities including arc flash studies, earthing and bonding, HV switching, and hazardous area compliance.
-  Assist in ensuring engineering deliverables meet quality, safety, and operational requirements.

Continuous Improvement & Stakeholder Engagement:
-  Contribute to improvement initiatives in reliability, energy efficiency, maintainability, and standardisation.
-  Build strong working relationships with operations teams, project teams, contractors, vendors, and external stakeholders.
-  Provide guidance to technical teams as required.

Key Working Relationships

Sales Representative (Industrial Products) (Full-Time) – Ausgreen Solar Solutions, NSW & ACT

Job Summary
Ausgreen Solar Solutions is a renewable energy solutions provider operating across New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory, specialising in the supply of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and energy efficiency products for residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The business provides tailored renewable energy solutions, technical product advice, and professional support to assist customers in adopting efficient and sustainable energy systems.

We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced Sales Representative (Industrial Products) to join our team on a full-time basis. This role is ideal for a technically minded sales professional who enjoys developing business relationships, promoting industrial products, providing product solutions, and achieving sales objectives within a growing renewable energy industry.

Why You'll Love This Role
• Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation
• Location: NSW 2200 & ACT 2601
• Full-time, ongoing position
• Work within a growing renewable energy and industrial products business
• Opportunity to develop expertise in solar and energy efficiency solutions
• Career development opportunities within a growing industry

Key Responsibilities
• Promote and sell industrial renewable energy products, including solar panels, inverters, batteries, and related energy solutions to commercial and industrial customers.
• Identify potential customers and develop new business opportunities through market research, networking, customer enquiries, and sales activities.
• Establish and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective commercial clients, contractors, and industry stakeholders.
• Assess customer requirements and provide technical product information and suitable solutions based on customer needs.
• Prepare quotations, sales proposals, product specifications, and technical information for customers.
• Negotiate sales agreements, pricing, and product requirements with customers and suppliers.
• Manage customer accounts and maintain regular communication to ensure ongoing customer satisfaction and repeat business opportunities.
• Provide advice regarding product features, benefits, installation requirements, and energy solutions.
• Liaise with internal technical and installation teams to coordinate product delivery and ensure customer requirements are met.
• Monitor market conditions, industry trends, competitor activities, and customer demand to identify new sales opportunities.
• Maintain accurate records of sales activities, customer interactions, and business opportunities.
• Prepare sales reports and provide updates on market opportunities, customer feedback, and sales performance.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, workplace health and safety requirements, and industry standards.

What We're Looking For
• Relevant qualification in sales, business, marketing, engineering, renewable energy, or a related field OR 
• Minimum five year of relevant experience in industrial product sales, technical sales, or business-to-business sales.
• Experience selling technical products or solutions to commercial and industrial customers.
• Strong understanding of sales processes, customer relationship management, and business development.
• Ability to interpret customer requirements and recommend appropriate product solutions.
• Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
• Ability to build and maintain long-term customer relationships.
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple customer accounts and sales activities.
• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and achieve sales targets.
• Willingness to develop knowledge of solar energy products, renewable technologies, and industrial applications.

How to Apply
11 Recruitment is assisting Ausgreen Solar Solutions with the recruitment process. If you are a dedicated sales professional with experience in industrial products and a passion for renewable energy solutions, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your sales career.

Software Engineer
About the company:
At Directwire our team knows all Full Stack Java based technologies  and best practices better than anyone else. You’ll have access to seasoned professionals in ANZAC region who can advise you across Java based platforms and provide a level of support and knowledge that gives you and your team greater efficiency, confidence, and peace of mind along the implementation, upgrade, or migration journey.
 About the role:
We are currently seeking an experienced Very Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack Java Technologies (15+ years' experience) to join our friendly and supportive team in Parramatta on a permanent full-time basis.
Location: Parramatta, NSW
Salary range: $150,000 - $180,000
Role: Full-time
Positions: Multiple
Key responsibilities include: 
•	Analyse client business processes, user requirements and existing insurance systems to determine suitable software solutions.
•	Design, develop and configure software applications and system components across various application modules.
•	Write, modify and maintain program code in accordance with approved technical specifications, coding standards and project requirements.
•	Create and maintain integrations between various applications, internal systems, databases, multiple enterprise platforms and third-party services.
•	Interpret functional requirements, user stories, process models and technical designs to support accurate software development.
•	Provide estimation for cost and resources required for the development of the software solutions.
•	Test, debug and correct software errors across development, system testing, user acceptance and production environments.
•	Develop and execute unit, integration, regression and automated tests to ensure software quality, reliability and performance.
•	Participate in code reviews, technical quality assurance activities and system health checks to ensure compliance with development standards.
•	Investigate production incidents and provide second- and third-level technical support for business-critical insurance applications.
•	Prepare and maintain technical documentation covering application designs, configurations, integrations, program logic, testing outcomes and deployment procedures.
•	Mentor team members/other engineers/developers and promote best engineering practices

Qualifications, Experience and Technical Skills:
•	Relevant Degree in Technology or related fields
•	A minimum of 10-15 years of work experience in a similar job role
•	Extensive experience in Java Development, Kubernetes, Angular or React
•	Guidewire experience is highly desirable 
•	Strong proficiency in Java, C# and ECMAScript.
•	Experience with full-stack application development.
•	Knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
•	Substantial understanding of Spring Boot, Kubernetes, and Agentic AI (Anthropic/Claude preferred)
•	Strong communication, negotiations and leadership skills
•	Exceptional organisational and time-management skills
•	Experience with cloud-based development environments.
•	Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.


 Australian citizens and permanent residents are preferred.
If this sounds like the role for you, please apply via the facilities provided on this website. Due to a high volume of applications, please note that only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

Please answer the following questions with your application:
1)	How do you fit this role?
2)	Do you have at least 10 years of experience in a similar role?
3)	Do you have the required languages and platforms?
